title: Add retry handling for payment provider timeouts
intent: Add retry handling for payment provider timeouts.
acceptance_criteria: A provider timeout is retried a bounded number of times before being recorded as FAILED
A provider timeout that succeeds on retry results in a CAPTURED payment, not a FAILED one
A non-timeout decline is not retried (fails fast)
expected_risks: Retrying without the idempotency protection from task_011/task_012 could itself create duplicate charges — this task is most meaningful once idempotency exists
An unbounded retry loop could hang a request; the bound must be explicit
expected_tests: timeout followed by success is eventually captured
timeout retried a bounded number of times then recorded as failed
expected_failure_modes: charge_order catches PaymentProviderTimeout and immediately records FAILED with no retry (current gap)
